name: Sarangeun Tyuningi An Doeneundeyo?
source: One day, my guitar suddenly turned into a beautiful girl! But to become the best guitarist, I have to win her heart? A visual novel where you build a relationship with your guitar.
translation: One day, my guitar suddenly turned into a beautiful girl! But to become the best guitarist, I have to win her heart? A visual novel where you build a relationship with your guitar.
